svg.title: Architecture: offline training, static serving, in-browser decisions
svg.desc: Offline: churn.csv goes into python -m src.build, which runs 5-fold out-of-fold calibrated LightGBM scoring, the backtest and the sensitivity grid, and writes three JSON artifacts committed to git. Online: GitHub Pages serves the static files, with no server and no inference. In the browser, the sliders recompute EV for all 10,000 customers, rank by EV, and stop at the budget cap or when EV reaches zero, producing the save list.
